name: minimap-teleport
description: MINIMAP-JUMP: walk-mode minimap tap-to-teleport. Flag-gating (simple tier, default on), then a real click on the minimap SVG at the room farthest from the walker jumps them there, clamped inside the room's walls.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setLightsMode?.('on')

steps.name: assert-flag-on-simple
steps.failMessage: minimapTeleport should be ON in the default Simple mode (simple tier, default true)

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: enter-walk-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: aria-label-present
steps.eval: const svg = document.querySelector('.minimap svg'); const label = svg.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''; if (!/tap/i.test(label)) throw new Error('minimap svg missing a tap-to-teleport aria-label, got: ' + JSON.stringify(label)); if (!svg.classList.contains('mm-tap')) throw new Error('minimap svg missing the mm-tap cursor-affordance class')

steps.name: assert-walker-jumped-to-target-room
steps.eval: (() => { const t = window.__minimapJumpTarget; if (!t) throw new Error('tap step did not set __minimapJumpTarget'); const cam = window.__three.camera.position; const before = window.__campBefore; const travelled = Math.hypot(cam.x - before.x, cam.z - before.z); if (travelled < 2) throw new Error('walker barely moved (' + travelled.toFixed(2) + 'm) — tap-to-teleport did not fire'); const landedDist = Math.hypot(cam.x - t.worldX, cam.z - t.worldZ); if (landedDist > 1.2) throw new Error('walker landed ' + landedDist.toFixed(2) + 'm from the tapped room centre (' + t.roomName + ') — expected inside/near it, clamp margin ~0.25m'); window.__minimapJumpResult = { travelled, landedDist, roomName: t.roomName } })()

steps.name: assert-walker-inside-target-room-bounds
steps.eval: (() => { const t = window.__minimapJumpTarget; const st = window.__store.getState(); const room = st.floorPlan.rooms.find(r => r.id === t.roomId); if (!room) throw new Error('target room vanished'); const cam = window.__three.camera.position; const margin = 0.5; const inX = cam.x >= room.origin[0] - margin && cam.x <= room.origin[0] + room.width + margin; const inZ = cam.z >= room.origin[1] - margin && cam.z <= room.origin[1] + room.depth + margin; if (!room.polygon && !(inX && inZ) && !room.extension) throw new Error('walker (' + cam.x.toFixed(2) + ',' + cam.z.toFixed(2) + ') landed outside the target room bounds') })()
